hypotheses.P0_integrated_tensor_paths_are_exact: All 729 paths reconstruct both mean-erasure and cyclic-substitution finite effects with at least 0.9999 Fisher fidelity and state relative error below 1e-4.
hypotheses.P1_residual_identity_path_is_insufficien: The all-identity path remains below 0.50 selected-fact fidelity for the mean-erasure effect in every run.
hypotheses.P2_selected_identity_correction_is_not_a: Discovery-ranked top 128 paths remain below 0.90 selected held-out-template fidelity in every run.
hypotheses.P3_five_hundred_twelve_paths_are_suffici: Top 512 paths reach at least 0.90 selected held-out-template fidelity in every run.
hypotheses.P4_selected_corrections_are_broader_than: Selected mean-erasure K90 exceeds unselected K90 by at least 32 paths in every run.
hypotheses.P5_bilinear_paths_construct_most_of_the_: Paths containing a bilinear arm have signed Fisher projection at least 0.60 on selected mean-erasure effects in every run.
hypotheses.P6_path_ranking_transfers_to_wrong_digit: The mean-erasure discovery ranking reaches at least 0.75 top-256 fidelity on selected cyclic-substitution effects in every run.
hypotheses.P7_ranked_paths_beat_random_banks: Selected mean-erasure top-128 fidelity exceeds the 95th percentile of twenty random 128-path banks by at least 0.10 in every run.
hypotheses.P8_path_program_transfers_templates: Selected top-256 mean-erasure fidelity differs by at most 0.10 between trained and held-out templates in every run.
hypotheses.P9_signal_gate_passes: Every finite-effect cell contains at least 64 effectful examples.
